title: Implementation Consultant III, Enterprise Restaurants
location: Remote, US | Remote - USA
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 A day in the life 
 As an Implementation Consultant III, you architect complex technical setups and lead high-stakes, multi-location rollouts for Enterprise clients. Leveraging deep expertise in Toast's technology suite, configurations, content hierarchies, and integration frameworks for multi-site operations.
 Your day might start with a working session with a brand's corporate IT team to map network requirements across multiple locations, move into a hierarchy that a franchisee can update without breaking corporate brand standards, and end with unblocking a peer on a tricky hardware escalation. You move fluidly between the technical detail and the executive conversation — one moment troubleshooting an integration, the next reframing a rollout timeline for a regional VP.
 You are a leader on the Technical Onboarding team. You mentor peers, spot workflow gaps before they become fire drills, and serve as the primary escalation point when advanced hardware and software challenges surface across the Enterprise deployment organization.
 What you'll do (Responsibilities) 
 Architect complex technical setups and design scalable configurations for multi-site operations
 Lead high-stakes, multi-location rollouts for Enterprise brands from design through go-live
 Lead integration frameworks that hold up across dozens or hundreds of sites
 Independently manage intricate franchisee and corporate relationships, proactively mitigating brand-level risks before they surface
 Act as the primary escalation point for resolving advanced hardware, software, and networking challenges
 Lead cross-functional initiatives and drive project success across the Enterprise deployment organization
 Partner with Integrations, Product, and Sales to remove blockers for large brands
 Provide internal QA for multi-unit rollouts, catching configuration issues before they reach the customer
 Mentor peers, identify workflow gaps, and present viable solutions that scale beyond a single project
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 
 5+ years of combined experience in POS, technology, or SaaS
 Familiarity with POS device installation and troubleshooting - onsite or remote 
 Demonstrated experience implementing complex hardware and software at scale, managing integrations, and applying advanced networking skills
 A master understanding of corporate IT and operational needs, with comfort working directly with corporate IT leaders and regional managers
 Advanced understanding of Enterprise configurations, above-store reporting, and third-party integrations 
 Proven ability to own and drive cross-team escalations to resolution
 Project management strength that requires no oversight — you improve Enterprise procedures on your own initiative and complete complex, multi-phased rollouts start to finish
 Impeccable judgment on complex corporate issues, with ownership of missteps without management prompting
 A self-starter's instinct for navigating multi-unit chaos and bringing structure to it
 Confidence building cross-functional relationships and influencing successful multi-team collaboration
 Leadership by example — a scalable mindset and a consistent willingness to help peers navigate complex multi-unit configurations
 Willingness to travel to various customer locations
 What will help you stand out (Non-essential Skills/Nice to Haves) 
 Experience with various customers within the Enterprise, Hotels, Sports, and Entertainment industry
 Proven experience operating in fast-paced, high-volume restaurants, hotels, sports and/or entertainment venue environments.
 Strong understanding of POS systems and restaurant operations workflows, or experience supporting multi-unit QSR or fast casual brands.

description:

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.
As a Senior Implementation Project Manager, you’ll lead complex and enterprise customer implementations from discovery through launch and transition to ongoing success. Reporting to the Manager, Implementation Project Management, you’ll guide multiple workstreams, align customer and internal stakeholders, and turn technical and business goals into clear delivery plans and measurable outcomes. Your work will help organizations adopt secure, productive ways of working and advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future.
How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US, with a preference for Pacific Time coverage.
What we're looking for:
 - Bring 5+ years of experience in project management, implementation, professional services, or a related field within Business-to-Business Software as a Service (B2B SaaS).
 - Lead complex customer implementations involving multiple workstreams, changing conditions, competing priorities, and diverse stakeholder groups.

 - Translate customer goals into practical strategies, project plans, milestones, decisions, and next steps while surfacing risks and dependencies early.
 - Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, including executive audiences, and lead difficult conversations with sound recommendations.
 - Bring strong technical curiosity and the ability to learn products quickly, with familiarity across SaaS, identity providers, single sign-on (SSO), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), Active Directory, command-line interfaces (CLI), endpoint management, or device trust.
 - Hold a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification and demonstrate a commitment to mentoring colleagues, improving delivery practices, and using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly to strengthen research, preparation, documentation, and workflows.

 - Lead complex and enterprise 1Password implementation and onboarding

title: Implementation Specialist, CMMC

description:
ABOUT SECUREFRAME
Secureframe helps organizations build, automate, and prove trust through modern security, compliance, and risk programs. Our platform helps customers manage evidence, policies, controls, vendors, personnel, assets, and audit readiness across frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-171, and CMMC.
We are expanding deeper into the defense industrial base with our CMMC product. For many customers, CMMC is not just a compliance requirement. It is the path to winning or retaining contracts with the Department of Defense, primes, aerospace and defense companies, government agencies, and regulated commercial buyers. Our opportunity is to make CMMC implementation faster, clearer, and more operational for companies that cannot afford to turn a lean team into a full-time compliance department.
ABOUT THE IMPLEMENTATION TEAM
The Implementation team sits within Secureframe's customer organization and works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Security, Support, and our partner ecosystem. This team is responsible for helping customers move from signed contract to real operational readiness: scoped environments, configured platform workflows, clear control ownership, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and a credible path to CMMC assessment.
This is an early role on a team we are building from scratch. The right person is not only comfortable delivering customer implementations; they want to help define what excellent CMMC implementation looks like at Secureframe. You will create playbooks, improve handoffs, identify repeatable delivery patterns, pressure-test service packaging, and help turn early customer engagements into a scalable implementation motion.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As an Implementation Specialist focused on CMMC, you will lead customer implementations and deliver hands-on technical remediation for defense customers preparing for CMMC Level 2 assessments. You will configure and administer Microsoft 365 GCC High and Azure Government environments, implement and validate security controls, and help customers develop the documentation and evidence needed for assessment readiness.
This customer-facing role combines project leadership, Microsoft systems administration, security engineering, and CMMC expertise. You will serve as the primary implementation owner, manage multiple engagements, troubleshoot technical issues, and translate compliance requirements into working configurations and repeatable operating procedures. You will execute technical work within the agreed scope and coordinate with customer IT teams and external partners on shared responsibilities and specialized remediation.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Lead end-to-end CMMC implementations from discovery and scoping through environment configuration, control validation, documentation, readiness milestones, and operational handoff.
 - Translate customer requirements into implementation plans with clear scope, timelines, milestones, owners, risks, dependencies, and success criteria; communicate progress and drive accountability across multiple engagements.
 - Translate CMMC Level 2 and applicable NIST SP 800-171 requirements into implementation tasks, identify control gaps, and execute remediation. Help customers operationalize CUI and FCI handling, asset categorization, evidence collection, and assessment preparation.
 - Map where controlled unclassified information (CUI) and federal contract information (FCI) live across email, file sharing, cloud applications, endpoints, engineering systems, specialized equipment, facilities, and third-party providers; document system boundaries and control ownership.
 - Configure Secureframe workflows for control mapping, evidence automation, policies, procedures, owner assignments, remediation tracking, and readiness reporting. Document technical configurations and control evidence, and contribute to System Security Plans (SSPs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), and assessment preparation.

 Location: Preference EST timezone to support International markets 
 A day in the life (Responsibilities) 
 Run demos that win the room. Build every demo from discovery. Show a 40-site group their own menu, their own workflows and the systems they already run, in their market's version of the product. Tailor it to each person in the buying group, from the head of ops to the IT lead to finance. Leave each of them with a reason to champion Toast.
 Run labs that end in a decision. Agree success criteria with the customer before the lab starts. Build and maintain the lab environment, track every issue, drive escalations and root cause analysis, and close the lab with a clear yes or no. No lab ends without an agreed next step.
 Own the technical outcome through go-live. The deal isn't won until the customer is live and it matches what we sold. Stay involved through procurement and handoff.
 Architect the solution. Design how Toast fits into a multi-location group's existing stack:
 All of it within what's actually available, and what payments rules allow, in each market.
 Lead security, IT and compliance reviews. Own vendor security questionnaires, PCI scoping conversations and the technical sections of RFPs.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Life Sciences - SF
location: San Francisco | San Francisco, California, United States
description:
About the team
OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with global pharma and biotech, CROs, and research institutions to deploy existing expertise across the R&D value chain to help customers design and ship production-grade AI systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, converting early deployments into repeatable system standards and evaluation practices that scale across regulated environments.
About the role
We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to push the frontier on what is possible today across drug discovery (e.g., target identification, molecular design, pre-clinical) and development (e.g., trial design, trial ops, biostats) by leading end-to-end deployments of our models inside life sciences organizations and research institutions. You will work with customers who are deep experts in their scientific or operational domains, translating real-world data, infrastructure, and constraints into production systems.
You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback loops, including evaluation benchmarks and acceptance criteria, that inform product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM to deliver in regulated contexts, including inspection readiness with audit trails and traceable evidence.
This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.
In this role, you will:
 - Design and ship production systems around models, owning integrations, data provenance, reliability, and on-call readiness across research, clinical, and operational workflows.
 - Lead discovery and scoping from pre-sales through post-sales, translating ambiguous workflow needs into hypothesis-driven problem framing, system requirements, and an execution plan with measurable endpoints.
 - Define and enforce launch criteria for regulated contexts, including validation evidence, audit readiness, outcome metrics, and drive delivery until we demonstrate sustained production impact.
 - Build in sensitive scientific data environments where auditability, validation, and access controls shape architecture, operating procedures, and failure handling.
 - Run evaluation loops that measure model and system quality against workflow-specific scientific benchmarks and use results to drive model and product changes.
 - Distill deployment learnings into hardened primitives, reference architectures, validation templates, and benchmark harnesses that scale across regulated life sciences environments.
You might thrive in this role if you:
 - Bring 5+ years of software/ML engineering or technical deployment experience with customer-facing ownership in biotech, pharma, clinical research, or scientific software; PhD, MS, or equivalent applied experience in a life sciences relevant field encouraged.
 - Have owned customer GenAI deployments end-to-end from scoping through production adoption, and improved them through evaluation design, error analysis, and iterative evidence generation that tightens acceptance criteria over time.
 - Have delivered AI systems in trial design, regulatory writing, or scientific operations where validation strategy, auditability, compliance constraints, and reviewer expectations shaped system design and rollout.
 - Communicate clearly across scientific, clinical, model research, technical, and executive audiences, translating technical tradeoffs into decision quality, risk posture, and measurable outcomes with credibility.
 - Apply systems thinking with high execution standards, consistently turning failures, escalations, and audit findings into improved operating standards, validation artifacts, and repeatable deployment playbooks.

description:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: 
 Samsara’s Strategic Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal. 
 In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship. 
 Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within. 
 This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. 
 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. 
 May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays. 
 You should apply if: 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. 
 You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

title: Account Manager
location: San Francisco | San Francisco, California, United States
description:
About Us
Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support.
About the Role
We're looking for an expert Account Manager to manage a portfolio of our largest B2B relationships. You will work with your peers on the Customer Success team and your Manager to develop and execute repeatable tactics for onboarding and managing ongoing relationships with the businesses in your portfolio. Your north star is to drive Rho product adoption for your clients at scale, allowing you to grow your customers' revenue and maintain high retention. In this role, you will work highly collaboratively with your teammates on the Success team and cross-functionally with the Product and Customer Service teams.
Responsibilities
 - Manage, retain, and expand existing client relationships in our middle-market, VC-backed start ups, and commercial segments.
 - Strategically collaborate with the Account Executive Team (Sales) to efficiently and effectively hand off and onboard new clients.
 - Build and nurture relationships with key accounts to understand and address their business needs, priorities, goals, and challenges to maximize client adoption of Rho’s entire product suite and services. 
 - Guide senior customer stakeholders through the changes needed to unlock Rho's full value, providing guidance to help them design the optimal enablement and adoption strategy to maximize their business value. 
 - Track and report key account metrics, such as revenue growth, retention, and customer satisfaction. 
 - Identify upsell opportunities and deliver consultative value.
Key attributes
 - Self-motivated with impeccable interpersonal and communication skills.
 - Bias for action, enthusiasm about technology and fintech, comfort with ambiguity, and high speed.
 - A high degree of comfort with drawing insights from analytics reports.
 - A valued team member who upholds Rho’s mission and professional values.
Qualifications
 - 2+ years of professional experience in a client-facing Customer Success/Account Management role 
 - Has experience managing large-scale implementations with 50+ users
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills
 - A track record of managing a large portfolio of clients efficiently and at scale 
 - Prior experience working in B2B SaaS, high-growth preferable
 - BA degree or higher
 - Prior background in accounting, finance, cards, or payment is preferred
Our people are our most valuable asset. This role is based out of our San Francisco office, with a base salary of $107,500 to $125,000 and an OTE of up to $145,000. Base salary may vary depending on relevant experience, skills, geographic location, and business needs. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, healthcare benefits and paid time off.
Diversity is a core value at Rho. We’re passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable environment for all those involved with our mission, including employees, contractors, candidates, customers and vendors. We believe every member of the Rho community enriches our ability to provide a broad range of ways to understand and engage with the market, identify problems, and drive solutions that align with our mission. We welcome all qualified applications and support each of our Rho’ers with ongoing professional growth opportunities.

description:

We’re a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We’re building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence.
 Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you’ll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar.
 For San Francisco Bay Area , New York, and Amsterdam residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. Our values, customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together are at the core of everything we do.
 About the role: 
 We’re looking for Solution Architects who are passionate about solving complex business challenges through innovative technical solutions. As a Solution Architect at Orb, you will play a critical role in bridging the gap between technology and business strategy, helping our customers navigate their most challenging and complex billing and monetization issues. You will have the opportunity to directly influence Orb’s product and go-to-market strategies and significantly impact our company's trajectory.
 In this role you will: 
 Drive sales deals : Partner with members of the sales teams to drive evaluations of the Orb product and help prospect companies understand the value of Orb. You’ll work on all parts of the deal process, from answering technical product questions to underscoring Orb’s security and compliance program.
 Pave the path for implementations : You’ll help future customers understand how the core pieces of the product fit their existing workflows, and how they can best use Orb for automation and intelligence. You’ll play a key role in shaping Orb’s roadmap around reducing time to value.
 Serve as a technical advisor in the field : Customers will look to you for expertise in both Orb’s products and related business systems. You’ll help them successfully craft solutions centered around Orb’s capabilities.
 Help strengthen Orb’s product : We value developer experience highly, and you’ll work to fill in product gaps through technical solutioning and monitor customers’ experiences to give feedback to product teams.
 About you: 
 3+ years of experience in a technical customer-facing role
 Clear written and verbal communication, especially around technical concepts
 Previous experience partnering with sales, product management, customer success to build process and repeatable motions
 Demonstrated ability to design and implement technical solutions that address complex business challenges through a value-selling lens.
 Excellent ability to translate technical concepts into non-technical language and vice versa, tailored to the audience.
 Strong empathy and understanding of customer needs, with a proven track record of building and maintaining strong customer relationships.
 A continuous learner who stays curious about new technologies and methodologies.
 Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
 Sales Methodology training (e. g. MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger Sales) is preferred.
 Not afraid to take calculated risks and innovate while balancing pragmatism.
 Ability to act as a thought leader by sharing best practices through forums such as Webinars, Orb blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures, and public-speaking events.

 Have prior experience in an early-stage startup

location: New York | San Francisco | New York, New York, United States
description:
ABOUT HEX
Hex is growing our team of builders on a mission to make everyone a data person. Our platform solves key pain points with today’s data and analytics tooling, and empowers anyone to explore data using natural language, with or without code, on trusted context. Thousands of customers like Ramp https://hex.tech/customers/ramp/, Figma https://hex.tech/customers/figma/, Stubhub https://hex.tech/customers/stubhub/, Anthropic, and Gamma love Hex https://www.g2.com/products/hex-tech-hex/reviews for our beautiful UI, agentic superpowers, and boundless flexibility.
Hex has raised over $100M from leading investors like Sequoia, a16z, Snowflake and Amplify. With office hubs in San Francisco and New York, as well as remote team members throughout the US and UK, we’re a high-agency team that ships fast and has fun doing it. Check out our Intro to Hex video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAXsnrNlavk and employee handbook https://www.notion.so/hexhq/Hex-Handbook-9fff0d42860e4f70815c599e0d1664d6 to learn more about what it’s like to work at Hex.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Hex helps thousands of teams explore, analyze, and act on their data every day — and as our customer base grows, so does the opportunity to deepen those relationships well beyond the initial sale.
We're looking for a Commercial Account Manager to own a dedicated portfolio of existing SMB and Mid-Market customers. You'll be the primary point of contact for renewals and expansion within your book, working to understand how customers are using Hex today and where there's room to grow — more seats, new use cases, deeper adoption across their data team.
You'll report to our Account Management Lead and be one of the founding members of Hex's Account Management function — a chance to build a new motion inside a fast-growing company, not step into a playbook that's already been written.
On any given day you might find yourself:
 - Owning renewals and expansion across your assigned book of existing customers (accounts 6+ months past their first renewal, SMB and Mid-Market)
 - Proactively surfacing expansion opportunities — additional seats, new use cases, upsell — that tend to get left on the table once an account moves past its initial land
 - Running your own forecast across the book, with quota split 70% against a growth (NDR) target and 30% against a retention (GDR) target
 - Partnering with Sales Engineering and Customer Engineering support to run technical conversations with existing customers
 - Helping define the AM playbook and territory model as one of the first people in the function
 - Coordinating the AE → AM handoff for accounts moving into your book
ABOUT YOU
To be successful in this role, you:
 - Have 3+ years owning a book of business in SaaS — account management, renewals, or a customer success role with a real commercial/quota component
 - Bring a track record of driving expansion, not just retention, in existing accounts, ideally in technical or data-adjacent software
 - Be comfortable being one of the first people in a new function, with no established playbook and no precedent yet for what "good" looks like
 - Be able to run a genuine commercial conversation (this is explicitly not a CSM role) while partnering closely with SE/CE on the technical side
 - Be disciplined enough to run real pipeline/forecast hygiene across a large book, not just a handful of strategic accounts
 - Bring genuine enthusiasm for cross-functional partnership — Sales leadership, SEs, and the AE team you're taking handoffs from
In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

title: Partner Manager, Franchise
location: Denver, CO - Hybrid
description:
About Gusto 
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
 All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
 AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.
 About the Role: 
 Franchise is one of Gusto's fastest-growing partner channels, and we are looking for a Partner Manager to own it. You will recruit and sign franchisors, and manage the partnerships once they are signed. When a franchisor becomes a Gusto partner, the franchisees in its network can access Gusto's payroll, benefits, and HR platform on partner terms. Franchisors are not traditional channel partners. They protect their brand, support independent owner-operators, and operate within legal limits on how they can endorse vendors. A signed agreement does not guarantee franchisee adoption. Your job is to make Gusto easy for a franchisor to approve and recommend, and to give franchisees a clear reason to choose us. OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems.
About the role
You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions.
You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground.
You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it.

 - Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence.
 - Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt.

 Are you bready* for a change?
 A restaurant owner switching to Toast shows up with a pile of paperwork from their old POS, a bank account to verify, and an opening date that isn't moving. title: Sales Onboarding Manager
location: San Francisco | San Francisco, California, United States
description:
Perplexity is hiring sellers fast, and every new seller has to learn a fast-moving product line: Enterprise, Comet, Computer and the API. We're looking for a Sales Onboarding Manager to own how new sellers go from their first day to selling on their own. You'll build the program, keep it current, run it, and certify that each seller is ready before they sell independently.
This is a high-ownership, highly visible role on a small Sales Enablement team. You'll partner with the Sales Enablement Lead and work closely with sales leaders, frontline managers, Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and Revenue Operations. Your goal is a robust, relevant, progressive and measurable ramp that gets faster as we scale.
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Sales Onboarding Manager owns the onboarding experience for Enterprise and Commercial Account Executives (AEs) and Business Development Representatives (BDRs), from Day 1 through field certification. You'll design the curriculum, keep it up to date as the product changes, lead the sessions yourself, manage the logistics of placing each cohort into the right sessions, and run the certifications that decide when a new hire is ready.
Company-wide new-hire orientation is owned by a separate onboarding role. Ongoing training for ramped sellers is owned by Sales Enablement. You'll partner with both so new sellers move smoothly from orientation into their sales ramp and then into working independently with ongoing training from Enablement.
RESPONSIBILITIES
 - Own the sales onboarding program. Co-design and run role-based ramps for BDRs and for Enterprise and Commercial AEs, including learning objectives, milestones and time-to-productivity targets for each stage. Where BDRs and AEs need the same foundations, they learn them together. Where the jobs differ, each gets its own track.
 - Build the BDR ramp. Teach new BDRs prospecting and outbound: ideal customer profile and persona research, account and territory rules, multi-channel sequences, cold calling, cold email, qualification, and clean handoffs to AEs. Get BDRs productive in the prospecting stack, including Salesforce, Apollo and the dialer.
 - Build and maintain content. Create and update modules, playbooks, talk tracks, demo guides, knowledge checks and self-paced content. Update materials as products, pricing, positioning and process change, and retire anything out of date.
 - Facilitate live sessions. Lead engaging, interactive sessions (virtual and in person) on Perplexity's products, sales process, customer personas, discovery, demos, objection handling and tools. Bring in subject-matter experts from Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and top sellers.
 - Run cohort logistics. Work with Recruiting and sales leaders to track incoming hires, assign each one to the right sessions for their role, segment and start date, and manage calendars, attendance, make-ups and pre-work.
 - Certify field readiness. Design and run role-specific certifications using clear rubrics. For BDRs, that means cold-call, email and qualification certifications. For AEs, it means pitch, discovery and demo certifications. Both roles also certify on tools. Calibrate scoring with BDR and sales managers, give actionable feedback, and decide when a new hire is ready to sell on their own.
 - Partner with frontline managers. Give managers visibility into each new hire's progress, flag risks early, and equip managers to reinforce onboarding through coaching and call reviews.
 - Measure and improve. Track completion, certification pass rates and ramp attainment. For BDRs, also track activity, meetings booked and accepted, and pipeline sourced. For AEs, also track time to first meeting, pipeline and closed business. Use the data and new-hire feedback to improve the program each cohort.
 - Scale with leverage. Use AI tools, including Perplexity's own products, to build content faster, personalize learning paths and automate repetitive logistics so the program keeps up with hiring.

 - 10+ years of experience in customer success, account management, consulting or professional services, including at least 4 years directly managing CSMs or account teams serving large enterprises.
 - A track record of delivering retention and expansion outcomes across complex enterprise accounts, including leading renewal and growth strategies in partnership with Sales.
